## Description {#details}

The <b>µOS++ Intrusive Lists</b> project is a C++ source code library designed to implement <b>µOS++ intrusive doubly linked lists</b>. These specialised lists eliminate the need for dynamic memory allocations by embedding linkage directly within the list elements, making them particularly advantageous for embedded systems.
